method: Opened category and nine product pages, read official descriptions and visually inspected main product photographs in browser. No claim that entire catalog was visually reviewed.

products.observation: Open tall cabinet, glass shelves, prominent vertical wood strip, wood back. Official description mentions Fresart decoration and LED lighting.
Tall closed cabinet, two vertically textured Fresart doors, wood frame and push-pull opening.
Tall two-door cabinet, rounded outer edges, integrated handle, recessed plinth. Official description mentions two shelves and three internal drawers.
Wood doors with sculptural relief, dark thin frame and raised legs.
Narrow tall cabinet, contrasting dark frame, stacked wood drawer fronts and upper flap.
Two tall narrow tower variants, dark outer frame, horizontal wood fronts.
Wood framed display cabinet, transparent glass doors, lower drawers.
Dark continuous frame and asymmetrical division of wood doors/drawers; no open niche shown in main photograph.
Three volumes, dark central module and wooden side drawer blocks projecting sideways.

suggested_translation_to_our_design.layout: Two lower doors and upper open shelf compartment, with central divider as required by structural design.
suggested_translation_to_our_design.appearance: Natural wood surfaces, softened edges, graphite spherical connectors, optional vertical slat relief on a facade.
suggested_translation_to_our_design.status: Research and concept recommendation; previous interactive sketches were not changed. Manufacturing details remain to be designed.
